_note: Site chrome, not a section. The nav is generated by PHP, so these are read with get_field() in vcc_render_nav() — kit/build-acf.py --check proves each one has a reader.

wordmark.label: Menu wordmark
wordmark.doc: The large word across the bottom of the open mobile menu. Blank uses BLACKTOP.

meta.label: Line under the wordmark
meta.doc: One short line beneath it — a strapline or the group name. Blank hides the line.

follow_label.label: Social heading
follow_label.doc: The small label above the social links. Blank uses Follow.

more_label.label: Overflow button
more_label.doc: The desktop button that opens the extra menu items. Blank uses More.
